_about: How an AIM batch id is minted: {BU}.{stamp}.{name}-[{code}]. The id is also the store folder's name, so the name is made safe for Windows. Read by the v2 worker (batch_ids.py, intake from the share) and by Paperboy (Aim::Intake, the Upload page). Both follow this file and nothing else; test/python/aim_v2/batch_id_cases.json is the table both test suites check against it.

name._about: The original file name without its extension; then every character matching unsafe_pattern removed; then runs of whitespace collapsed to one space and the ends trimmed; then cut to max_length characters; fallback when nothing is left.

stamp._about: strftime format, in this IANA time zone -- not the clock of whichever machine minted it.
